title: Grateful Dead Live at Irvine Meadows Amphitheatre on 1989-04-28
lineage: Sony TC-D5M master deck and cassette, no n.r. playback -> Tascam DVRA1000 @24/96, direct to DVD+RW
source: Sennheiser MKE2002 omni's(x2) HRTF @ 6'4" -> Sony TC-D5M "B"n.r. on the master. From Row WW, section 2, at the right front corner of the sbd, a few feet RoC.

ai_review.summary: A highly praised recording that captures an exact, nostalgic rendition of "Touch of Grey", delivering strong emotional impact despite limited technical detail.
ai_review.review: The reviewer is ecstatic about hearing this show again, especially the flawless recreation of the closing "Touch of Grey". While no specific audio‑technical comments are made, the gratitude expressed suggests the recording meets fan expectations for fidelity and enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review conveys strong positive sentiment about the performance; lacking concrete recording details keeps confidence at medium, but overall impression warrants a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the song sounds "exactly as it was", implying satisfactory fidelity, though no explicit comments on soundboard/audience mix or clarity are provided.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed commentary on set structure; the highlight is the closing song, which is described as exactly reproduced and emotionally resonant.
